userStories.description: As the host studio, when a peer uploads a file (≤256 KB chunked over WS, or >256 KB via ephemeral S3) I need to assemble bytes safely, verify sha256, write atomically under the per-node folder, broadcast a node-patched diff, and tell the relay to delete the staging object.

On file-upload-intent: validate via FileUploadIntentPayloadSchema; resolve target path via resolveNodeFile (basedir = node folder, relPath = sanitized filename); reject if extension not in allowlist (same set as POST /nodes/:nodeId/files/upload at apps/studio/src/api.ts line 178); reject if size > 100 MB; reply with `rpc-result { ok:true, id:reqId, payload:{ via, key?, putUrl? } }` where via comes from relay's amended payload (US-058)

On file-bytes chunk: append base64-decoded bytes to chunks[seq], update sha256 hash, increment receivedBytes; if eof:true assemble Buffer.concat(chunks), verify final sha256 matches intent.sha256; on mismatch reply `rpc-result { ok:false, reason:'integrity' }` + discard buffer

On file-upload-done (S3 path): GET from envelope.payload.getUrl (presigned by relay), stream bytes, verify sha256, writeFileAtomic, then send `rpc-result { ok:true, id:reqId }` to relay so relay can DeleteObject (US-058)
